work.name: Resolian
work.summary: Industrial placement within a GMP-compliant analytical laboratory supporting R&D and regulated client projects.
highlights: Designed an iGC-SEA flow-rate case study demonstrating up to a 50% reduction in run time for larger probes, evidencing capability for varied-flow-rate method development.
Authored multiple time point stability study reports as lead author, with deliverables undergoing technical and QC review before submission, ensuring professional documentation.
Applied iGC, SEM, PXRD, DSC, DVS, TGA and light microscopy across sponsor projects to support material understanding and sample assessment.
Maintained accurate laboratory notebooks, ADF and audit trails across GMP projects, contributing to multiple sponsor reports.
Streamlined light microscopy workflows by replacing a four-step manual composition process with a single composite-image tool, improving consistency and presentation quality.
Created microscopy training resources and delivered a session to three analysts, with materials shared across the wider laboratory team to support consistent practice.

work.name: JD Wetherspoon

highlights: Managed teams of up to 20 staff within a 90+ person team, overseeing onboarding, training and shift operations.
Improved internal audit scores by 15%, contributing to the site's first all-green audit in 10 years.
Led a regulatory inspection achieving a 5/5 rating, holding personal licence and ensuring full compliance with licensing laws.

projects.name: Surface Energy of Sucrose at Modified Particle Sizes
projects.summary: Characterised surface energy heterogeneity across three sucrose fractions using iGC-SEA, PXRD, SEM and BET surface area analysis.
highlights: Found that processing route, not particle size, was the dominant influence on surface energy, with direct implications for blend homogeneity and compactability.
Poster presentation at the Analytical Research Forum 2026.

projects.name: iGC-SEA Python Package
projects.summary: Developing a Python package for post-processing SMS-IGC-SEA surface energy CSV export data.
highlights: Multi-table CSV parsing, with reproducible surface energy and acid-base calculations.
Provides more detailed analysis and customisation than proprietary software for developed modes.
